paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea: the LORD invites EVERYBODY. "Turn to Me and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other." (Isaiah 45:22) Not just Israel, not just the folks who already know the address. All the ends of the earth. If you've ever worried you're too far out to be invited, the LORD already said "all."

Why can you trust Him with that? Because He is the One who made the earth and didn't make it to be empty (Isaiah 45:18), and because He doesn't mumble from some dark corner. He says, "I, the LORD, speak the truth; I say what is right." (Isaiah 45:19) Idols can't do any of that. They get carried, they never carry, and the people who trust them walk off in disgrace (Isaiah 45:16). The LORD is a righteous God and Savior, and there is none but Him (Isaiah 45:21).

So what do you do with that today? You turn to Him, and you keep turning. He swore by Himself that every knee will bow before Him (Isaiah 45:23), and that in Him "all descendants of Israel will be justified and will exult." (Isaiah 45:25) That's why my ovens stay ready, baker. The One who calls you is the One who saves you, so come NEAR.
